name: Vishas' Memoir shortens every Brand cooldown by 25 percent (#1770)
contract: Vishas' Memoir 300795 is SpellFamily 21, passive (Attributes 0xc0), with one SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) effect: MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), BasePoints -26 + DieSides 1 = -25 percent, EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 0x2, the bit carried by the Brands (Brand of the Damned 807682 and its ranks, RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime 60000; Brand of the Unworthy 501380, 60000; Brand of the Profane 562390, 8000). Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to both the spell and the category recovery (Player.cpp:11446-11456) and none of those records carries SPELL_ATTR6_NO_CATEGORY_COOLDOWN_MODS. 60000 * 0.75 = 45000. Burrow Bolt 802269 (word 1 = 0) is the untouched control. The final steps cast Brand of the Damned on a hostile creature and read the cooldown the server actually started; a miss does not matter because the cooldown starts on the cast.

steps.label: Learn Brand of the Damned rank 1 so the cooldown path can be exercised end to end
Before the talent: Brand of the Damned cooldown is untouched
Vishas' Memoir is applied as a passive
Brand of the Damned cooldown is 25 percent shorter (op 11, -26+1 percent)
Brand of the Damned rank 7 cooldown is 25 percent shorter
Brand of the Unworthy cooldown is 25 percent shorter
Brand of the Profane cooldown is 25 percent shorter
Burrow Bolt is not a Brand and keeps its cooldown
The real cooldown started by the cast is 45 seconds, not 60
